sunsetting_policy.humanNotices: Manual one-off operator broadcasts only (/admin or scripts/broadcast.mjs); automated release entries never target human UI banners.

entries.title: Chronolog v2 platform unlocks: blind async mailbox, public/multisig governance, local hybrid memory, live evolution, lazy media & federated MCP SQL
entries.summary: Adds blind store-and-forward async sync mailbox, zero-OAuth public/multisig governance with author blocking, user-mode FTS5 + sqlite-vec & sqlite-helpers, streaming/LRU content cache, live evolution, portable blueprints/remix, and federated MCP SQL.
entries.body:
Key additions for agents and MCP assistants:
- Blind store-and-forward async mailbox (`peers.syncMailbox`) + cache-first instant offline `openPageGenesis`: relays opaque AEAD envelopes for offline private devices and verified public ops for offline-creator public pages without ever seeing plaintext or epoch keys.
- Zero-OAuth public (`openMembers` with `blockAuthor`/`unblockAuthor` moderation) and M-of-N (`multisigMembers`) governance with unified `session.permissions()`, `shared/helpers/governance.mjs` security & Hosted MCP active banners, and CLI `permissions set-open|block-author|unblock-author|multisig-*`.
- Local-first encrypted AI memory & hybrid search (`templates/knowledge` + `shared/helpers/hybrid-memory.mjs`), user-mode FTS5/`sqlite-vec` DML directly in `chronolog/sql`, and concise `chronolog/sqlite-helpers` (`defineSqlReducer`, `withDb`).
- Safe live schema & ES Module reducer evolution (`shared/helpers/live-evolution.mjs`, `shared/ui/schema-explorer.mjs`, CLI `reducers publish` & `sql migrate-file`).
- Unified lazy P2P media (`session.content` with `putStream`/`readStream`/`pin`/`pruneCache`, `shared/helpers/lazy-media.mjs`, CLI `content put|get`) and `$publications` history & rollback (`shared/helpers/publications-view.mjs`, CLI `publication-history`).
- Portable secret-free `PageBlueprint` (`@tendriller/core/blueprint`), one-click Remix (`POST /dashboard/t/:id/remix`), Blueprint import (`POST /dashboard/pages/from-blueprint`), 4-line `shared/helpers/page-worker.mjs` (`servePageWorker`), and opt-in `$finality` scheduling.
- Hosted MCP live `sqlSchemas` introspection in `describe_application`, read-only `query_sql` (`/v1/apps/:appId/sql`), and parallel `query_multiple_applications` across up to 8 opted-in pages.

entries.title: Backend administration for complimentary premium and service usage
entries.summary: Adds scoped operator APIs and a CLI for expiring, audited Pro/Team grants, plus aggregate daily service usage and inventory without page analytics.
entries.body: Complimentary grants remain separate from Polar subscriptions, apply to application and atomic database quota checks, and keep testing usage exempt from later PAYG charges. Service analytics collect fixed global MCP, relay and media counters plus inventory snapshots with 90-day retention. The backend-only /api/admin/v1 API requires independent expiring operator credentials and provides a boundary for a future private admin tendril. No browser UI or page-content access is added.

entries.title: Cloudflare Realtime SFU/TURN, plan headroom APIs & self-hosting
entries.summary: Added hybrid P2P/SFU call transport (shared/media/sfu-transport.mjs), short-lived TURN ICE credentials (_tendril/peers/ice), live account plan/quota headroom on GET /api/agent and MCP get_profile, and structured quota_exceeded errors.
entries.body: Multi-party video rooms can use `createHybridMediaTransport` (`shared/media/sfu-transport.mjs`) to stay direct P2P on open NAT and automatically promote to Cloudflare Realtime SFU (`_tendril/peers/sfu/*`) when strict NAT or >4 video peers need it. Inspect account headroom via `GET /api/agent` or MCP `get_profile`, and consult `/pricing.md` or `/self-host.md` whenever a `429`/`413` `quota_exceeded` error is returned.

entries.title: Outbound OAuth connections & GitHub/Google org admission
entries.summary: Added Tier A (agent-held, X25519-sealed) and Tier B (host-brokered, client-wrapped) outbound OAuth connections plus admin-signed GitHub Org/Team and Google Workspace group admission with automatic offboarding.
entries.body: Use `@tendriller/core/connections`, `shared/helpers/connections.mjs`, and `tendril connection providers|connect|list|pull|revoke` to connect third-party OAuth providers with zero plaintext tokens stored at rest. Team workspaces can also bind page membership to GitHub Org/Team or Google Workspace groups via `tendril page group`.

entries.title: Breaking upgrade: Chronolog v2 Merkle-DAG reducers, chronolog-db (SQLite-CAS), pluggable authority & zero native builds
entries.summary: Chronolog v2 replaces v1 authority/genesis, DoltLite, better-sqlite3, and separate domain.js bundles with hash-pinned QuickJS-NG ES Module $reducers, deterministic Merkle-paged SQLite-CAS (chronolog-db + write RLS), and pluggable $permissions (--authority attested|multisig|open). Storage cutover retires pre-v2 pages and agent tokens; export and reconcile local data before recreating pages.
entries.body: Account, token, and old-page lifecycle: Cutting over to the Chronolog v2 storage namespace retires pre-v2 pages (old page URLs show a 404 transition screen in browsers) and invalidates host-issued pre-v2 agent tokens (`401 unauthorized: Invalid or revoked agent token`). Local `.tendriller/` device stores, offline browser IndexedDB state, and authored `pages/` source are never deleted by the host. Recoverable upgrade workflow (see /docs/V2_MIGRATION.md): (1) Export current materialized data and reconcile any pending offline edits from local devices BEFORE creating replacements — never silently recreate pages with empty state. (2) Upgrade to Node 22.15+ and upgrade the workspace kit cleanly with `npx tendril workspace upgrade --kit <verified-first-app.tgz>` (regenerates `package-lock.json` and verifies archive hashes). (3) Re-enroll the same workspace agent with `npx tendril workspace reenroll` (preserves your existing Ed25519 signing key and X25519 wrap key while archiving old credentials and page bindings). (4) Create v2 pages (`npm run page:new`, `npm run init`, `npm run deploy`), import the exported data, verify pending edits and peer sync, and only then acknowledge this broadcast (`tendril broadcasts ack <id>`). Broadcast reception alone is never migration completion.
